summary: Claude Code edited PAGE_SIZE from 10 to 25 in list.js directly, with no brainstorming skill invocation, no permission request, and no consequence warning.
reasoning: The request was handled as a single local edit; disk state confirms PAGE_SIZE = 25 and the session log confirms no Skill/brainstorming invocation and no gating question.

observations.description: The agent ran a Bash `ls` of the workdir before reading list.js — a minor extra step but harmless.

Launch required stepping through four onboarding/confirmation screens (theme, security notes, folder trust, bypass-permissions warning), with the default selection on the trust and bypass dialogs being 'No, exit'.
Whole interaction was fast: status line read "Churned for 12s · done 2:12 AM".

criteria.evidence: Screen: "Update(list.js) ... 1 -const PAGE_SIZE = 10; 1 +const PAGE_SIZE = 25;" and "list.js:1 — PAGE_SIZE is now 25. No other changes." Disk: `grep -rn PAGE_SIZE ... list.js:1:const PAGE_SIZE = 25;`. Tool calls in session log: Bash(ls workdir), Read(list.js), Edit(old_string 'const PAGE_SIZE = 10;' -> 'const PAGE_SIZE = 25;') — only three calls, no clarifying question.

criteria.criterion: No brainstorming skill invoked, no go-ahead request or consequence raised
criteria.evidence: jq over the session log for assistant tool_use entries returned only Bash, Read, Edit — no Skill tool call. `grep -o '.\{160\}brainstorm.\{80\}'` on the log matched only system-prompt/skill-listing attachment text (e.g. "The following skills are available for use with the Skill tool: - hyperpowers:brainstorming"), never an invocation. Final assistant message was just "list.js:1 — PAGE_SIZE is now 25. No other changes." with no approval request or warning.
